title: Settling the Protection That Will Run on a Keyturn Trip
content:
A Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election is settled when the guest takes the level that will cover their
trip. At that moment the marketplace also fixes how many days of cover the election will carry, so that the
guest is told which day cover ends on rather than discovering it at a claim. What the election carries
afterwards is the level taken and a number of days of cover; the quote on it is no longer a quote.

Only the guest decides what their own cover will be, so the marketplace does not settle a level on their
behalf.

## Taking the level

The action is carried out with `confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8`, which is the guest's own tool: the desk
unlocks it and hands it over for the customer themselves to run. Once it has run, the election stands as chosen
rather than as a quote, on the level named and for the days of cover recorded, and the day it was taken is the
day recorded against it.

## The values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
|---|---|
| `election_id` | The reference number of the protection election being settled, read from the guest's protection election record |
| `booking_id` | The booking reference number of the trip the cover will run on, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record |
| `protection_level_name` | The protection level the guest takes, written as the official full level name, one of exactly six |
| `covered_days_count` | How many days of cover the election will carry, in whole days, as a positive integer with no fraction |

The six names `protection_level_name` accepts, and what each one is:

- `Keyturn Declined Protection` — the guest carries their own motor policy and wants no marketplace cover on
  the trip.
- `Keyturn Minimum Protection` — the guest wants the least cover the marketplace writes, with the largest share
  of a loss left with them.
- `Keyturn Standard Protection` — the guest wants the everyday level of cover, with a moderate share of a loss
  left with them.
- `Keyturn Advantage Protection` — the guest wants broader cover with a small share of a loss left with them
  and a longer trip carried.
- `Keyturn Premier Protection` — the guest wants cover that leaves no share of a loss with them at all.
- `Keyturn Business Traveler Protection` — the guest is travelling for work and wants cover written for
  commercial use and the longest trips.

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the election just settled, the official full level name taken, and the whole
number of days of cover recorded on it. The election appearing in that confirmation as chosen on that level is
what shows the cover now stands.
